question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
SELECT 
    pt.topping_name,
    COUNT(*) AS quantity
FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders c
JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders r ON c.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN pizza_recipes p ON c.pizza_id = p.pizza_id
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(p.toppings, ', ')) AS x(topping_id)
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON CAST(x.topping_id AS INTEGER) = pt.topping_id
WHERE r.cancellation IS NULL OR r.cancellation = ''
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY quantity DESC
